QuestInfo.name: [Esfera] Moon and Sun
QuestInfo.0: The moon and sun are getting closer. You need to hurry. But you need to know Will and the Black Mage's purpose before you reach Will.
QuestInfo.1: You need to read Tana's final memory. Defeat around 200 #bDark Executors#k for Melange to focus.
QuestInfo.2: You were shown the memory of when Tana met the #rBlack Mage#k. It seems she was going to cooperate with the him to escape her destiny. But it seems her will wavered after meeting Jean... It's time. Stop Will and save Tana.
